en: The image depicts a vintage postcard illustration of a corner building with the name 'ANTON SUESS' prominently displayed in large yellow letters across the storefront. The building has numerous display windows with curtains and mannequins or goods inside. Several well-dressed pedestrians from a historical era, possibly late 19th or early 20th century, walk by. There is a small cart in the foreground with the text 'Anton Suess' and 'Graz'. The color palette suggests an antique style.
